EnglishInfo.Description:
Le Hameau de Clotaire B23 is a beautiful 70 m2 apartment located in the new Hameau de Clotaire residence, in the Cognet quarter of Alpe d'Huez.

It has 2 double bedrooms, 1 of which is a suite, a sleeping alcove in the hallway, 2 bathrooms, and 1 toilet.

The apartment can accommodate up to 6 people.

It includes a large, east-facing living room with a view of the mountains and a fully equipped open kitchen (including a filter and Nespresso coffee machine, a toaster, a kettle, a juicer, and fondue & raclette equipment). You will also have access to a large balcony, an indoor parking space, and a ski locker.

The Hameau de Clotaire residence offers 2 lifts, a lounge area, a heated swimming pool with sauna, a hammam, and a laundry room.
